audience: HR teams who keep employee profiles and company news in Namely

useCases.title: Find who reports to a manager
useCases.text: The AI lists employee profiles with job title, manager and status, and shows who reports to a person.

useCases.title: List everyone in a department or office
useCases.text: The AI lists groups such as departments and offices, and the members of one group with their details.

useCases.title: See birthdays and work anniversaries in the feed
useCases.text: The AI lists company feed events, such as birthdays, work anniversaries and new arrivals, and reads the comments on one.

useCases.title: Run a saved report
useCases.text: The AI runs a saved Namely report by id and returns its columns and rows. It can sum up the result.

useCases.title: Post an announcement or comment on the feed
useCases.text: The AI posts a markdown announcement to the company feed, optionally mentioning people, or comments on a feed event.

useCases.title: Update an employee profile
useCases.text: The AI changes standard profile fields such as name, emails, start date, manager or job title. It writes live HR data, so confirm first.
